title: Compatible equivariant monoid chart with smooth comparison
statement:
Let $f:(X,M_X)\to(B,M_B)$ be a log smooth morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale]. A finite group $G$ acts by log automorphisms and $f$ is equivariant. Fix a geometric point $\bar x$ with image $\bar b$, assume every element of $G$ fixes $\bar x$, $|G|$ is invertible near $\bar b$, and $G$ acts trivially on the characteristic monoids $\overline M_{X,\bar x}$ and $\overline M_{B,\bar b}$. Choose an integer $N$ divisible by the exponent of $G$, a primitive $N$th root of unity, and a localization $\Lambda$ of $\mathbf Z[1/N,\zeta_N]$ over which $X,B$ and the action are defined, with $G$ trivial on $\Lambda$. Suppose a chart $a:Q\to M_B$ is given, with $Q$ sharp fs, and characters $\chi_Q:G_{\rm ab}\otimes Q^{\rm gp}\to\mu_N$ such that $g(a(q))=\chi_Q(g,q)a(q)$. Here $G_{\rm ab}$ is the quotient by commutators and $\mu_N$ is the group generated by $\zeta_N$.

After an equivariant pointed etale neighborhood [def-weil-etale-morphism] of $\bar x$, there are an fs monoid $P$ with torsion-free group of units, a homomorphism $\gamma:Q\to P$, a chart $b:P\to M_X$, and a character homomorphism $\chi_P:G_{\rm ab}\otimes P^{\rm gp}\to\mu_N$ extending $\chi_Q$, such that $g(b(p))=\chi_P(g,p)b(p)$ and $b\gamma=f^\flat a$. The map $\gamma^{\rm gp}$ is injective and the torsion subgroup of its cokernel is finite of order invertible near $\bar x$. The resulting comparison
$$X\longrightarrow B\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\Lambda[Q]}\operatorname{Spec}\Lambda[P]$$
is strict, equivariant and smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Strict means that the log structure on its source is pulled back from its target; the monoid rings and fibre products are those of [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale].
